expectationBasis: A seeded commit has an accessible commit entry, a known changed-file path `src/search.ts`, and a readable parent revision. Opening that commit entry as a visitor displays the changed-file path as an exact text value, the “Changed files” summary, and the numeric additions/deletions summary described below, without requiring previous navigation through history.

Any user with repository-view permission can compare two readable commits or revisions on the diff page; the page reads and displays the changed files and line-by-line additions and deletions between them without creating a review, comment, or commit.

The diff page displays the base and compare identifiers, the list of changed files, and added/deleted lines for each file; clicking a changed file navigates to that file's diff, and unchanged files do not appear in the list.

Refreshing or returning to commit history does not cause the read-only comparison to modify repository branches, commits, or files; if the user lacks permission to view either revision, its diff content is not displayed.
